PRISM by TÂCHES — Installation Guide
Version 1.0.0

WHAT'S IN THIS PACKAGE
- PRISM.pkg — the installer (VST3 + AU, ~3.6 MB)

HOW TO INSTALL
1. Double-click PRISM.pkg
2. If macOS blocks it ("unidentified developer"): right-click the .pkg,
   choose Open, then Open again — or System Settings > Privacy & Security
   > "Open Anyway"
3. Follow the installer (Continue, Install, enter your password)
4. Restart your DAW and rescan plugins if needed

FIRST USE
macOS may warn once per format when the DAW first loads PRISM:
System Settings > Privacy & Security > "Open Anyway", then confirm.

WHERE IT INSTALLS
~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/PRISM.vst3
~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/PRISM.component

QUICK START
- Drop PRISM on any track: live spectrum, loudness (EBU R128),
  true peak, stereo imaging and a beat-synced waveform
- Route another track into PRISM's sidechain to compare on Ch2
- Settings (gear): 7 color themes + presets
- GRID chip on the waveform: beatgrid editing (set first beat, shift,
  BPM fine-tune, warp markers); playhead right or centered
- Press F for true fullscreen; mouse wheel over the waveform zooms

Requires macOS 14.6+ and a VST3/AU host (Ableton Live, Logic, Reaper...).

Enjoy! — TÂCHES
